rows.en: Let my song reach you!
Geez! You've got to do better, or I'm in trouble!
That's it, I don't have the confidence to team up with you.
From now on, I'm doing things my own way too.
I could barely keep up with what was right in front of me.
When you're tired, that's exactly when you need vitamin-rich carrots!
Yay! We succeeded, right? Thank goodness!
You've got to come see my next concert!
Thanks again this time. Oh, I'll treat you at Nyan-Nyan next time.
That went well! Let's keep it up from now on!
You always help me. Thank you.
Idiot, idiot, idiot! I was really worried!
You're here. That alone is enough for me to keep going.
It's part of the job. Even when it's tough, I have to try.
I'm glad it worked, but... hmm...
I never thought it'd get this hard.
Oh, I have to get back! I'll be late for work!
We did it! Total success!
Let's keep working together!
I'm always the one being helped, aren't I?
Thanks to you, I've got a little more courage now!
Thank you for helping me!
I'm always the one being helped. Thank you so, so much.
I wish I could be like you, just once.
That was wonderful! I really look up to you!
Huh!?
I was scared... so scared...
Everyone, hold me tight... to the ends of the galaxy.
rows.notes: Heard "ginga no hata made" (galaxy's flag); her song line is "ginga no hate made" (to the ends of the galaxy).

rows.en: Because I wanted to tell you. Happy birthday, Alto.
Alto, can you hear me? Alto?
Um, it's like a big cave, and there are lots of eggs...
Alto!
No!
Yes.
Alto, big brother, this is... this is right, isn't it?
rows.notes: "Onii-chan" next to Alto; Ozma or Brera, left as "big brother".

rows.en: Everyone, hold me tight! To the ends of the galaxy!
rows.notes: Heard "ginga no hata made" (galaxy's flag); her song line is "ginga no hate made".

rows.en: That's... the enemy?
Help me.
Big brother!?
Yes, big brother!
Kira!
Thank you, Brera!
A Deculture selection! Welcome to the Nyan-Nyan Shop! Kira!
Welcome! Welcome to the Super Dimension Restaurant Nyan-Nyan! Kira!
rows.notes: Transcript says "chojiku hanten Nyan-Nyan" with kanji for reversal (hanten); the shop name is the restaurant (hanten, 'inn/restaurant'); the ui text list carries the same name without an English entry.

rows.en: Welcome! Take your time.
That item's a good deal!
I have that one too!
Staring at it that long won't get you a discount.
Still can't decide?
Come on, just go for it and buy it!
rows.notes: Heard the kanji for "win" (katchaou); read as "kacchaou" (buy it).

rows.en: You can't go wrong with anything here! Trust the Nyan-Nyan Shop!
I think you've got to buy it by now!
I'm scared. I wonder if I can really sell anything.
Thanks for buying! Oh, sorry, you haven't bought it yet!
Aww, you're not buying?
No way... you came this far and you're not buying...
Why? Why won't you buy it?
Thank you for your purchase! Kira!
Thank you for buying! Kira!
I'm so happy you bought it!
Be sure to come again! I'll be waiting! Kira!
Next time, buy even more!
Thank you very much! Kira!
With me minding the shop, you won't buy anything, will you?
rows.notes: Heard "mise-ban" with odd kanji; read as "mise-ban" (minding the shop).

rows.en: My chest... it hurts...
At this rate the manager will get mad at me again.
Buy it all up!
rows.notes: Rest of the transcript ("Gendron, Gakuma de") is unintelligible; only "buy it all up" kept. Possibly a joke line.

rows.en: Welcome back, as always! Welcome to the Super Dimension Restaurant Nyan-Nyan! Kira!
rows.notes: Same shop name as rnk_701 (hanten written with kanji for reversal).

rows.en: You came back! Thanks as always. Welcome to the Nyan-Nyan Shop! Kira!
I have that one too! If you buy it, we'll match!
If you stare at me like that, I'll get nervous.
Oh, I recommend that one! It's really amazing!
I'm happy to spend so long with you, but could you buy something soon?
What would it take for you to buy something?
I want you to buy it! Absolutely!
I was hoping you'd buy that one. Of course you will, right?
I believe in you! You're going to buy it!
rows.notes: Heard the kanji for "win" (katte); read as "katte" (buy).

rows.en: My big brother used to say, "If you're going to regret it, just buy it."
rows.notes: Onii-chan: Ozma or Brera, left unnamed.

rows.en: I believed in you more than anyone.
Right, you have your reasons for not buying too.
